server.name: common-practice
server.description: Read-only access to Common Practice's published pages and sample courses.

protocolMetadata.instructions: Read Common Practice's published service information and sample training courses. Course outlines supply page order; get_page reads the body. Training examples are illustrative, not assessed or endorsed material. Browser progress stays private. The Contact form is a UI preview and cannot send messages.

_published_faq.name: How do I add common-practice to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add common-practice to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.withcommonpractice.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is common-practice MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 16, 2026, common-practice scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is common-practice's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 16, 2026, common-practice scores 97/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 4 of 4 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to common-practice?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to common-practice in search-research on the Manufact MCP catalog include Agentic Atlas: Agent Design Patterns, GDELT Cloud, BookDNA, Lyon, and Exa.
